```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
#### Translate
translate_DNA <- function(dna_data){
  clean_dna <- gsub("[^ACTG]", "", dna_data)
  DNA_strings <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(clean_dna)
  translations <- as.character(Biostrings::translate(DNA_strings))
  return(translations)
}

#### Trim CDR3
trim_CDR3 <- function(seq_vec){
  return(substr(seq_vec, 2, nchar(seq_vec)-1))
}

top_groups <- function(results, clone_var){
  return(table(results[[clone_var]])[order(table(results[[clone_var]]), decreasing = T)])
}

unproductive <- function(results){
  return(results[which(!grepl("\\*", results$VHH, fixed = F)),])
}

# function def
simple_weighted_CDR3_Search <- function(dat, 
                                        sequences,
                                        insert_cost,
                                        delete_cost,
                                        substitute_cost){
  # Count junction_aa length
  dat$junction_aa_length <- nchar(dat$junction_aa)
  
  # For each Query CDR3
  for (i in 1:length(seqs$sequence)){
    # Pull the name
    CDR3_ID <- seqs$sequence_id[i]
    # Pull the junction_aa
    CDR3 <- seqs$sequence[i]
    
    # calculate distance metric indexed by Query VHH name
    dat[[CDR3_ID]] <- stringdist::stringdist(seqs$sequence[i], 
                                             dat$junction_aa, 
                                             method = "lv",
                                        weight = c(insert_cost, 
                                                   delete_cost, 
                                                   substitute_cost))
  }
  
  # Create a data frame for our results
  results <- data.frame()
  
  print("Compiling results...")
  
  # Subset min-distance hits
  for (i in 1:length(seqs$sequence)){
    # For each CDR3 ID
    CDR3_ID <- seqs$sequence_id[i]
    # Pull CDR3
    CDR3 <- seqs$sequence[i]
    
    # Pull minimum distance, add some amount
    min_dist <- (min(dat[[CDR3_ID]])+5)
    
    tmp <- dat[dat[[CDR3_ID]] <= min_dist, 
               c("sequence_id", 
                 "junction_aa",
                 #"cdr1_aa",
                 #"cdr2_aa",
                 "clone_id",
                 "sequence_alignment")]
    
    tmp[["Query_junction_aa"]] <- rep(seqs$sequence[i], each = nrow(tmp))
    tmp[["Query_sequence_name"]] <- rep(seqs$sequence_id[i], each = nrow(tmp))
    #tmp[["Query_cdr1_aa"]] <- rep(seqs$cdr1_aa[i], each = nrow(tmp))
    #tmp[["Query_cdr2_aa"]] <- rep(seqs$cdr2_aa[i], each = nrow(tmp))
    tmp[["Query_CDR3_dist"]] <- rep(min_dist, each = nrow(tmp))

    # print(head(tmp))
    # print(colnames(tmp))

    
    # Rearrange columns
    tmp <- tmp[,c("Query_sequence_name",
                  "Query_junction_aa",
                  "sequence_id",
                  "junction_aa",
                  "Query_CDR3_dist",
                  #"cdr1_aa",
                  #"Query_cdr1_aa",
                  #"cdr2_aa",
                  #"Query_cdr2_aa",
                  "sequence_alignment",
                  "clone_id")]
    
    colnames(tmp)[ncol(tmp)-1] <- "assembled_sequence_alignment"
    
    # We want to merge the closest match to Seqs
    results <- rbind(results, tmp)
  }
  return(results)
}
```


```{r, echo = F, warning=F, eval = F}
tab <- top_groups(df, "clone_id")
tmp <- df[df$clone_id %in% head(as.numeric(names(tab)), 25),]
  
for (nm in unique(tmp$clone_id)){
  tmp_frame <- tmp[tmp$clone_id == as.numeric(nm),]
  
  # Translate VHH
  tmp_frame$VHH <- translate_DNA(tmp_frame$sequence_alignment)
  # Trim CDR3
  tmp_frame$junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(tmp_frame$junction_aa)
  # Pull most frequent CDR3
  common_CDR3 <- names(table(tmp_frame$junction_aa)[order(table(tmp_frame$junction_aa), decreasing = T)][1])
  
  cat("Group ID: ", unique(tmp_frame$clone_id), '\n', sep = '')
  cat("Unique VHHs: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$VHH)), '\n', sep = '')
  cat("Unique CDR3s: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$junction_aa)), '\n', sep = '')
  cat("Most-frequent CDR3: ", common_CDR3, ' (with ',nrow(tmp_frame[tmp_frame$junction_aa == common_CDR3,]), ' CDR3 observations)\n', sep = '')
  print(ggseqlogo(as.character(tmp_frame$junction_aa), seq_type='aa', method = 'p') + 
    theme_classic() + ggtitle(paste(" CDR3 Logo Plot for cluster with the most common CDR3 sequence:\n               ", common_CDR3, sep = '')))
}
```

### Align sequences by query sequence

#### Convert to fasta

```{r}
convert_to_fasta <- function(dat, file_name){
  dat <- dat[,c("DB_sequence_id", "DB_VHH")]
  dat$DB_sequence_id <- paste(">", dat$DB_sequence_id, sep = '')

  D <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq(nrow(dat)), function(i) t(dat[i, ])))

  write.table(D, file = file_name, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
}
```


```{r}
file_name <- "~/Desktop/Shoemaker Lab/VHH_all_query_CDR3_results17Jan24.fasta"

```

### Load Fasta and MSA

```{r}
# Load for MSA
mySequenceFile <- "~/Desktop/Shoemaker Lab/VHH_all_query_CDR3_results19Jan24.fasta"

mySequences <- readAAStringSet(mySequenceFile)

myFirstAlignment <- msa(mySequences, method = "ClustalOmega")
```


```{r}
# dat <- results
cluster_by_family <- function(dat, file_name){
  # First, convert the file to fasta
  convert_to_fasta(dat, file_name)
  # Then, we reload the results
  mySequences <- readAAStringSet(file_name)
  
  # Adjust the name for saving
  file_name <- gsub(".fasta", ".csv", file_name)
  
  # Perform the alignment
  
  print("Beginning Alignment")
  print(Sys.time())
  myFirstAlignment <- msa(mySequences, method = "ClustalOmega")
  print("Finished.")
  print(Sys.time())
  # Bind the data together
  tmp <- as.data.frame(cbind(as.character(myFirstAlignment@unmasked), 
                               myFirstAlignment@unmasked@ranges@NAMES))

  row.names(tmp) <- NULL

  colnames(tmp) <- c("Aligned_VHH", "DB_sequence_id")
  
  tmp$Aligned_VHH <- paste("'", tmp$Aligned_VHH, sep = '')
  
  tmp <- merge(dat, tmp, by = "DB_sequence_id")
  
  tmp <- na.omit(tmp)
  
  tmp <- tmp[order(tmp$pct_identity, decreasing = T),]
  
  write.csv(tmp[c("DB_sequence_id",
                  "Query_junction_aa",
                  "DB_junction_aa",
                  "pct_identity",
                  "experiment",
                  "Aligned_VHH")], file = file_name, row.names = F)
  
  # return(tmp)
}
```


```{r}

for (nm in unique(results$Query_sequence_name)){
  file_name <- paste("~/Desktop/Shoemaker Lab/VHH_",nm,"_query_CDR3_results19Jan24.fasta", sep = '')
  cluster_by_family(results[results$Query_sequence_name == nm,], file_name)
}
```
